lede: The biggest thing on the board this week is the Ouray joint work session Monday where the City Council and County Commissioners will take public comment on a proposed intergovernmental agreement to hand city law enforcement over to the Sheriff's Office starting January 1 — that's a structural change worth paying attention to. Closer to home, Telluride Town Council meets Tuesday with a public hearing on a vesting period extension and a morning conversation about rolling out automated license plate reader cameras. San Miguel County's BOCC and Planning Commission both carry affordable housing items — including a public hearing on fee waivers for Mountain Village's Ilium Valley project — and there's a Ballot Measure 5A information meeting Monday for anyone still sorting through that one.
